items.title: As Production Dips, Natural Gas Cash Prices Ascend
items.summary: Spot natural gas prices advanced on Thursday even as Mother Nature’s penchant for mild November conditions endured. It marked a second day of gains driven by bargain hunting amid hints of coming cold and lighter production readings.

items.title: Sharply Lower Demand Keeps Canadian Imports at Bay, NatGas Prices Low for Northeast
items.summary: Heating demand in the East is running more than 2 Bcf/d behind last year entering the winter season.

items.title: Tourmaline Targets Alberta Data Center to Boost Natural Gas Demand
items.summary: Management at Canada’s largest natural gas producer, Tourmaline, said they were looking to tap into Alberta’s expanding data center market.

items.title: Excelerate’s Bahamas LNG Deal Expands Caribbean Reach as US Supply Grows
items.summary: Excelerate Energy has secured an 11-year LNG supply agreement supporting a planned Bahamas hub, with initial deliveries expected next year through its Jamaica operations.

items.title: Seasonally Stout Storage Build Sends Natural Gas Futures Drifting
items.summary: The latest government inventory print came in lighter than expected but well above historical norms, leaving prompt month natural gas futures adrift on Thursday as analysts calculated that Lower 48 supply would prove sufficient to meet winter demand.

items.title: Mild Weather Eroding Winter Premium, Tanking US Natural Gas Prices Across the Curve
items.summary: Natural gas forward prices are nosediving, weighed down by unseasonably warm weather and stubborn production that continues to outpace demand.

items.title: LNG Canada Feedgas Steady as Station 2 Natural Gas Prices Strengthen
items.summary: LNG Canada kept feedgas flowing steadily to its Kitimat, BC, export terminal in September, even as flaring notices stretched across most of the month.

items.title: Fundamentals, Forecasts Square Off as Natural Gas Futures Drift Sideways
items.summary: Bullish production and LNG feedgas readings kept December natural gas futures just barely in positive territory as of midday on Thursday despite dismally low heating demand in the forecast.

items.title: Natural Gas Storage Build Misses Estimates, but Surplus Widens
items.summary: The US Energy Information Administration (EIA) reported a smaller-than-expected 77 Bcf injection into Lower 48 natural gas storage for the week ended Oct. 30, widening the inventory surplus despite a modest miss against forecasts.
